text:
maria: starting prod terraform apply in 10m for release/4.2.1. main changes: nat-gw sizing, kms key rotation for logs, and a small provider upgrade pinned to hash. tagging @cheng @alex for smoke and rollback watch.

deploy-bot: PLAN READY
- workspace: prod
- diff: 3 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy
- plan id: pb-27654-abcd

maria: plan looks small. provider pin is `hash: v1.13.2+commit.abc123` — we pinned to avoid upstream behaviour change. module-network v2.4 -> v2.4.1 (hotfix).

cheng: ack. I'll be on watch for the NAT scaling, will validate route propagation and healthchecks. If we see >5% 5xx, we abort and flip traffic to fallback AZ.

alex: confirm the rollback playbook. If apply fails or KMS key policy change is rejected, we revert modules by running:
```
terraform apply -target=module.network -auto-approve
terraform apply -refresh=false -var='rollback=true'
```
Also have runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tf-cutover

jen: ops-oncall will be on pager for 30m post-apply. I'll post a quick health check script in 5m.

ops-oncall: received. I'll set a temporary alert threshold (nat-error-rate > 3% for 2m) and escalate to SRE if tripped :alert:

maria: starting timer, will kick the deploy-bot at T+10. if no thumbs from @cheng/@alex in 8m we hold.

cheng: :thumbsup: I'll ack in 6m after preflight checks complete.

deploy-bot: APPLY STARTED (pb-27654-abcd)
- executor: terraform-apply-runner-7
- command: `terraform apply -auto-approve`

alex: seeing expected plan apply logs. KV-cache warmups might take 30s.

maria: apply finished with exit code 0. small drift fixed. running smoke tests now.

cheng: smoke green for routes and egress. no 5xx spikes.

jen: health script passed — latency and error budgets OK. I'll keep a 15m tail check.

ops-oncall: alerts clear. closing watch in 10m unless someone calls abort.

maria: thanks all. documenting release notes with the provider pin and KMS rotation note. will add a postmortem link if anything flares up. :tada:
